title: Beyond Good and Evil
summary: Nietzsche attacks easy certainties: philosophers' 'truths' are often hidden personal needs, morality has a history and is not fixed, the herd fears anything that stands out, and a free spirit questions everything, accepts struggle, creates their own values and becomes who they are.
